reuse.why: Builds on link.findOrCreateBank, db helpers, handleSyncResponse and syncAccount, folds the five near-identical linkers into linkBankSyncAccount, and reuses the unlink field reset via an extracted clearAccountBankLink.

duplication.why: Removes the per-provider link and Pluggy/Akahu download copies; the remaining repetition is that each provider's sync source and account-id extractor are stated twice (createBankSyncLinker and refuseIfAlreadyLinked).

placement.why: Holder lookup and closed-account check live in accounts/link.ts and the URL in server-config; the refuseIfAlreadyLinked wrapper is defined in the middle of the app.method registration block rather than with the linkers.

scope.why: Beyond the four requests it rewrites every provider linker and merges the Pluggy/Akahu download functions; justified by adding Fintegra but much larger than needed, and the client files get a Fintegra entry the request said was out of scope.

maintainability.why: One link path plus one guard wrapper per handler is easy to own; the wrapper's name no longer describes the closed-account and replace-link behaviour it also carries, and provider identity is passed in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through refuseIfAlreadyLinked and linkBankSyncAccount; unlink reuses clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated linkers and downloaders were actually merged; only the provider/accountId mapping is repeated openly in the registration block.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink added to LinkAccountBaseParams; processBankSyncDownload gains an akahu||fintegra condition; no call site bypasses the guard wrapper or linkBankSyncAccount.
